stepTitle: The cross entropy loss is still well defined for all possible outputs of our model.
stepBody:
In this part, we'll consider an alternative to the logistic function.
Instead of using the logistic function as our choice of $$f, $$ let's say we instead use a scaled inverse tangent function
$$f(x)= rac{1}{\pi}\operatorname{arctan}(x)+ rac{1}{2}$$
This choice of $$f$$ has the exact same tail-end behavior as $$\sigma(x).$$ In other words, it is always between $$0$$ and $$1$$.
Is the above true?##figure1.gif##
